data.name: Clementia
data.gender_notes: Clementia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'clemens', meaning merciful, kind, and gracious. The name Clementia was often given to girls in ancient Rome whose families held positions of power or influence. It was also used as a title for the goddess of mercy. The name Clementia carries the meaning “Merciful, Gracious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Clementia usually hope their child will grow to embody merciful, gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine grace and mercy.
data.etymology: Clementia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Merciful, Gracious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Clementia total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: קלמנטיה
in_hebrew.meaning: קלמנטיה היא שם שפירושו חסד ורחמים בעברית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קלמנטיה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בלטינית ומשמעותו חסד, רחמים ואדיבות. השם קלמנטיה קשור למילה הלטינית 'קלמנס' שפירושו רחום או חסיד. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים כסמל לחסד ולרחמים של אלוהים. השם קלמנטיה מראה על האופי הנחמד והאדיב של הנושא אותו.

in_greek.name: Κλημεντία
in_greek.meaning: Κλημεντία σημαίνει καλωσύνη και συμπόνια στην ελληνική γλώσσα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κλημεντία προέρχεται από το λατινικό όνομα Clementia, που σημαίνει καλωσύνη, συμπόνια και ευγένεια. Στην ελληνική γλώσσα, το όνομα Κλημεντία συνδέεται με τη λέξη κλέος που σημαίνει δόξα και η λέξη μήτηρ που σημαίνει μητέρα. Το όνομα Κλημεντία είναι σύμβολο της αγάπης και της συμπόνιας του Θεού και αντανακλά την προσωπικότητα της носителя ως ένα άτομο με μεγάλη καρδιά.

in_latin.name: Clementia
in_latin.meaning: Clementia significat clementiam et misericordiam in Latin
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Clementia derivatum est ex Latino vocabulo 'clemens', quod significat clementiam, misericordiam et benignitatem. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Clementia fuit usitatum ut symbolum misericordiae et clementiae Dei. Hoc nomen indicat personalitatem eius qui huius nominis est, ut sit pius, benignus et misericors.

in_english.name: Clementia
in_english.meaning: Clementia means clemency, mercy, and kindness in English
in_english.long_meaning: The name Clementia originates from the Latin word 'clemens', meaning clemency, mercy, or kindness. It has been used as a Christian name to signify the mercy and kindness of God. In the Christian tradition, Clementia is associated with the virtues of compassion, empathy, and benevolence. The name Clementia is often given to girls born into families of strong Christian faith, reflecting the parents' desire for their child to embody these virtues. Historically, the name has been in use since the early Christian era and has been borne by several saints and martyrs. Today, Clementia remains a popular name among Christian families worldwide, symbolizing the enduring values of kindness, mercy, and compassion.

data.cultural_impact: The name Clementia evokes images of kindness, compassion, and mercy, traits that have been held in high regard throughout history. In ancient Rome, Clementia was a virtue that was highly respected, and a person named Clementia was associated with generosity and forgiveness. Similarly, in Christian tradition, the name Clementia is a reminder of God's mercy and forgiveness towards humanity.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Clementia carries deep spiritual significance as it reflects God's mercy and compassion towards humanity. It is a reminder that even when we make mistakes or fall short, God is always ready to forgive us and offer us grace. The name also inspires us to live merciful and compassionate lives, treating others with kindness and forgiveness, just as God has done for us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Clementia, derived from the Latin word "clemens" meaning merciful, represents the Christian virtue of forgiveness and compassion. It symbolizes the gentle and compassionate heart of God, who extends mercy and forgiveness to all, inspiring us to do the same.

historical_references.reference: Saint Clementia of Rome, daughter of a Roman senator, was martyred during the persecutions of Emperor Maxentius in the early 4th century.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Clementia continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Hannah Clementia in Dublin, Ireland credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Clementia, which means "Merciful, Gracious". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
